short: An English galleon captained by Francis Drake, famous for its circumnavigation of the globe.
full:
Originally named the Pelican, the ship was launched in 1577 and renamed the Golden Hind by Francis Drake in 1578. It served as the flagship for his expedition, which raided Spanish settlements along the Pacific coast of the Americas and captured the immensely wealthy treasure galleon Nuestra Señora de la Concepción.

Returning to Plymouth in 1580, Drake and his crew became the first English expedition to circumnavigate the globe. The immense captured wealth helped pay off England's national debt. The Golden Hind was subsequently preserved in Deptford as an early museum ship, where it remained for decades before finally succumbing to rot.
